settings.title: Four things we refuse to cut corners on.

settings.editor: Not just the building. Each unit has its own contact alarm, cameras cover the corridors around the clock, and footage is kept for thirty days.
Every indoor unit is heated and ventilated, so documents, electronics and upholstery come out the way they went in — even after a Dutch winter.
No admin fee, no deposit, and no increase in your first twelve months. If you move to a different size, you just pay the difference.
Drive-up bays at all three facilities, with free trolleys and a covered loading area so you are never carrying boxes across an open yard in the rain.

tabs.tab_title: How long do I have to commit for?
tabs.tab_content: There is no minimum term. You pay per month and give two weeks' notice when you want to leave. Move out early and we refund the unused days.

tabs.tab_title: Can I change to a bigger or smaller unit later?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, and there is no fee. Tell the facility manager and we move your contract across — you only pay the difference from that date.

tabs.tab_title: Who has a key to my unit?
tabs.tab_content: Only you. Bring your own padlock or buy one at reception. Staff cannot open your unit without you present.
Anything perishable, living, flammable or illegal. Food, plants, animals, fuel, gas bottles, fireworks and chemicals are all out. Everything else is fine.
Not automatically. Some home contents policies cover items in storage, so check yours first. If it does not, we can arrange cover from €4 per month.
